title: The Sorceress Summons
description: A skeletal undead figure rises from green mist, reaching toward a single red rose on a vine-covered wooden stool. In the sky above, a glowing blue sorceress with crescent moon eyes and flowing black hair emerges from a blood-dripping portal amid lightning and colorful clouds. A brown rat stands on its hind legs in the foreground beside a checkered cloth and scattered papers.
prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy scene showing a skeletal undead rising from swirling green mist, one bony hand reaching for a red rose resting on a wooden stool covered in vines. In the stormy sky, a glowing blue female sorceress with crescent moon eyes and long flowing black hair emerges from a bloody portal. A realistic brown rat stands on hind legs in the foreground. Garden setting with red curtains, flowers, chairs and scattered papers on the ground, lightning in the background, highly detailed, vibrant yet dark color palette.
